builds.name: Reference: Mana spell-and-attack
builds.goal: Reference for Ezreal: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A mobile ranged skirmisher who lands repeated Qs to recover cooldowns and mixes attacks with mark detonations. Confirm Q on-hit/Spellblade behavior and W mark detonations; count Q hit rate and ordinary attacks. Manamune transformation and repeated R damage are not guessed from base stats. A stacked mana item, real Spellblade attacks and haste test spell/attack cycling.
testPlan: Kit question for Ezreal: Confirm Q on-hit/Spellblade behavior and W mark detonations; count Q hit rate and ordinary attacks. Manamune transformation and repeated R damage are not guessed from base stats.

Start with the early core (Early Tear, Trinity or Manamune by lane needs) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A stacked mana item, real Spellblade attacks and haste test spell/attack cycling. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Manamune must stack and transform in game; no guessed transformed damage or extra Spellblade items.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Manamune must stack and transform in game; no guessed transformed damage or extra Spellblade items.
Full cost 16,433 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Early Tear, Trinity or Manamune by lane needs. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Serylda's Grudge, Spear of Shojin, Guardian Angel are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
